column3: every HDFS case but hdfs-adhoc-21 and hdfs-11741: the study checks' markers and workloads, the named cases' workloads, HDFS-17897's fix reverted, the time family's workarounds, a quorum call's replies read in its loggers' order (every QJM check, 05-10), a block recovery's primary the live replica not yet tried with the least DataNode UUID (28-30), a LightWeightGSet sized as for a 64 MB heap (52), TestEncryptedTransfer's client without block-acquire retries (11)
hdfs-adhoc-21 only: r7 plus the DataNode handshake on a joined thread of its own and its workload's skip loop at the three largest strides
hdfs-11741 only: trunk with HDFS-11741's fix reverted (an old bug) and its own hook generation
